class.name: GDScriptTypeParameter
class.brief_description: A read-only description of a generic type parameter declared on a [GDScript] class.
class.description: Describes a single generic type parameter declared directly on a class, such as [code]T[/code] in [code]class Box[T][/code] or [code]K[/code]/[code]V[/code] in [code]class_name Pair[K, V: RefCounted][/code]. Instances are produced by [method GDScript.get_type_parameter_list] and are immutable snapshots of the reflected data.

members.member: The declared upper bound of the parameter, in the same shape as the entries returned by [method Script.get_script_property_list]. Empty when [member has_bound] is [code]false[/code].
Whether the parameter declares an upper bound (for example [code]T: Resource[/code]). See [member bound].
The ordinal position of the parameter in its class's declaration, starting at [code]0[/code].
Where the parameter was declared. Currently always [code]&"class"[/code], as only class-declared parameters are reflected.
